print("hdravy: Q,K,V relnorms (init 3.14 for 64x384), O relnorm (init 1.11), bilinear bQK, OV spectrum")
def pr(sv):
    sv = np.asarray(sv)
    p = sv / (sv.sum() + 1e-12)
    return (p.sum()**2) / (np.sum(p**2) + 1e-12)

for l in range(4):
    lw = W[f"ln1_w.{l}"]; lb = W[f"ln1_b.{l}"]
    for j in range(6):
        s = slice(64*j, 64*(j+1))

        Qa = np.concatenate([Q*lw, Q@lb[:,None]], axis=1)

        M = Qa.T @ Ka
        svM = np.linalg.svd(M, compute_uv=False)
        CV = O @ np.concatenate([V*lw, V@lb[:,None]], axis=1)
        svOV = np.linalg.svd(CV, compute_uv=False)

        print(f"L{l}H{j} nQ={np.linalg.norm(Q)/3.14:5.2f} nK={np.linalg.norm(K)/3.14:5.2f} nV={np.linalg.norm(V)/3.14:5.2f} nO={np.linalg.norm(O)/1.11:5.2f} | QKsv top4={svM[:4]/svM[0] if svM[0]>0 else svM[:4]} prQK={pr(svM):5.1f} asym={asym:4.2f} || OVsv top4={svOV[:4]} prOV={pr(svOV):5.1f} nOV={np.linalg.norm(CV):7.1f}")
    print()
